Hot Disk TPS 2500 S brochure
Product catalog summary
Overview
The TPS 2500 S is the flagship thermal constants analyser from Hot Disk AB, designed for precision analysis of thermal conductivity, thermal diffusivity, and specific heat capacity across various materials. It complies with ISO Standard 22007-2 and is suitable for testing solids, liquids, powders, pastes, and foams.
Key Features
Operative simplicity and high performance with Hot Disk sensors.
Capability to test anisotropy in materials such as laminates, polymers, and fibrous materials.
Suitable for quality control testing, both online and near-line, with TPC/IP control.
Customizable according to application specifications and temperature range.
Low maintenance costs with recurrent software upgrades.
Software Modules
The TPS 2500 S offers nine software modules, including Isotropic Standard, One-Dimensional, Anisotropic, Slab, Thin Film, Specific Heat Capacity, Structural Probe, Low-Density/Highly-Insulating, and Automatization modules.
Technical Specifications
Thermal Conductivity: 0.005 to 1800 W/m/K.
Thermal Diffusivity: 0.1 to 1200 mm/s.
Specific Heat Capacity: Up to 5 MJ/m K.
Measurement Time: 1 to 1280 seconds.
Reproducibility: Typically less than 1%.
Accuracy: Better than 5% for thermal conductivity.
Temperature Range: -235 °C to 1000 °C.
Power Requirements: Adjusted to regional line voltage.
Sample Dimensions: Varying sizes for bulk, slab, and one-dimensional testing.
Sensor Types: Kapton, Mica, and Teflon sensors available.
Temperature Control
With Furnace: Ambient to 750 °C (1000 °C oxygen-free).
With Circulator: -35 °C to 200 °C.
